units.function: Out-of-process Node plugin worker manager with bidirectional stdio JSON-RPC, host callbacks, invocation scopes, proactive company scopes, streamed execute logs, process lifecycle and crash restart.
units.dependencyDirection: Depends on Paperclip plugin SDK protocol, shared manifests, adapter tracing, host-provided handlers/config/environment and Node child_process/readline; plugin lifecycle, Dispatcher and environment drivers depend on it.
units.keyDataModels: Worker handle/status/diagnostics, pending RPC, host-minted ActiveInvocation, proactive company set, ExecuteLogRoute, open stream channel and in-memory manager/startup locks.
units.lifecycle: Forks one shared worker per installed plugin, initializes with manifest/config, routes calls and nested host requests, tracks invocation/log scope, shuts down by RPC/signals, rejects pending work on exit and schedules memory-local crash restart.
units.testAssessment: A 1,056-line suite with four real NDJSON worker fixtures passes all 37 tests and strongly covers company-scope host callbacks, proactive scopes, timeout resolution and execute-log routing. It omits stream notification authorization, same-company forged log ids, cancellation/effect ambiguity, crash/backoff escalation, initialization recovery, shutdown drain, lifecycle races, sandbox/resource controls and Secret-safe logs. The no-newline framing case is also absent.
units.designRationale: Isolate plugin crashes from the host and enforce host-minted company context while supporting long-running sandbox calls, proactive integrations and streamed output through one reusable worker.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs independent Connector execution nodes that safely multiplex or isolate tenants, prove runtime generation, bind responsibility/data authority, cancel or deduplicate effects and retain Secret-safe evidence across cloud/local deployments.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE host-minted invocation capabilities, exact company-scope checks for nested calls, minimal environment inheritance, bounded streaming concepts, timeout normalization, pending-call cleanup and graceful escalation states. Redesign around per-installation/per-tenant isolation, framed byte-level parsers, durable leases/generations, cancellation/idempotency/effect receipts, structured redacted errors and attested execution nodes.
units.responsibilityConflict: An idle worker can emit Stream notifications for arbitrary company ids; same-company invocation ids remain forgeable on a shared process. Crash counters reset after initialize so common crash loops never escalate. Timed-out work is not cancelled, worker logs/stderr/errors can leak Secrets, Node children have no filesystem/network/resource sandbox, and proactive scopes provide ambient company authority without task/human/data contracts.

units.function: Real-child-process regression suite for plugin RPC timeouts, invocation/proactive company scopes, stderr context and execute-log routing.
units.dependencyDirection: Exercises production WorkerHandle and SDK host guards with four purpose-built CJS workers; it does not use the full plugin loader, database or deployment sandbox.
units.keyDataModels: RPC timeout, invocation id/scope, proactive company allowset, nested host request, execute log route/sink and worker stderr/error.
units.lifecycle: Starts fixture workers, performs scoped calls and nested callbacks, streams/forges logs, times out calls and stops each worker.
units.testAssessment: All 37 tests passed locally. Scope and log-route adversarial coverage is valuable, but stderr assertions normalize unsafe raw error propagation and major lifecycle/isolation failure modes are absent.
units.designRationale: Protect security regressions in company context and output routing with actual process/protocol behavior rather than only mocked units.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs Connector compatibility tests that prove tenant isolation, runtime attestations, cancellation/idempotency and responsibility evidence against hostile workers and failures.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the real fixture-worker harness, forged-id cases, proactive scope matrix and output caps. Add hostile no-newline/log metadata/stream cases, crash-loop/restart generations, delayed effects after timeout, startup/stop races, OS sandbox probes and Secret absence assertions.
units.responsibilityConflict: The suite tests company scope but not accountable human, ResponsibilityContract, data purpose/export authorization or effect receipts, and it leaves known cross-company Stream and same-company log-forgery paths untested.
